verdict.rationale: Langfuse documents capturing traces of all LLM calls through native Python/JS SDKs, 100+ integrations, OpenTelemetry, or LiteLLM. Most integrations capture usage and cost automatically, and latency is tracked and queryable in dashboards and the Metrics API. Community users independently praise its tracing, though one notes retries for structured outputs clutter traces. Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of per-call input/output capture (only implied via observations recording input and context), and a fix for the noted retry-trace clutter edge case.
